description:
Transform a schema from one format to another through the ARAMAI mapping engine.
Formats: jsonschema | shex | avro | jsonld | sql | osi | osi-json | owl | linkml | protobuf | odcs | graphql | odm | synapse
(odm decodes only; osi-json is the OSI coder in its JSON serialization — the form dbt ingests;
synapse encodes only — the Sage Bionetworks Synapse draft-07 subset with a registered-schema $id;
its output is plain JSON Schema, decodable via jsonschema; protobuf is a single proto3 .proto file,
alias proto; odcs is a Bitol Open Data Contract Standard v3 YAML data contract; graphql is a GraphQL
SDL type-system document, alias sdl — the universal fallback for importing any CMS content model,
since every headless CMS can emit an SDL schema; decode imports the content model and skips the
generated query surface — root operation types, Connection/Edge/PageInfo pagination, filter inputs —
with an honest lossiness summary).
Mapping: 'inferred' (label/type matching against a target hint), 'explicit' (a SIA mapping-guide
JSON: autoMatchByMapsTo, fieldMappings [{sourceElementIds, targetElementIds, transformName}],
taxonomyDirectives, drops), or 'ai' (Claude proposes a plan; the same validation gate accepts or
rejects it — requires a server-configured Anthropic key and Editor/Admin project membership, and
sends the schemas to the Anthropic API server-side). The response carries the produced schema,
the executed plan (replayable), and an honest lossiness ledger of everything the transformation
could not preserve.

caseInsensitive.description: Inferred mapping: ignore label case (default true).

guide.description: For explicit mapping: the SIA mapping guide as JSON text. For ai mapping: optional free-text guidance for the model.

sourceFormat.description: jsonschema | shex | avro | jsonld | sql | osi | osi-json | owl | linkml | protobuf | odcs | graphql | odm

synapseName.description: For synapse output: the schema name segment of the $id (default: derived from the root type).

synapseOrg.description: For synapse output: the Synapse Organization name for the $id (default 'example'; org.sagebionetworks is reserved).

synapseVersion.description: For synapse output: the semver segment of the $id (default 0.0.1; Synapse rejects re-registering an existing version).

targetFormat.description: jsonschema | shex | avro | jsonld | sql | osi | osi-json | owl | linkml | protobuf | odcs | graphql | synapse

targetHintFormat.description: Format of the optional target hint schema.

targetHintSchema.description: The schema to map toward. Required for inferred mapping.

vendor.description: For sql output: postgres (default) | mysql | sqlserver.
